newsitem.title: USA: Illinois soybean seeding nears completion.
newsitem.headline: Illinois soybean seeding nears completion.

text.p: Soybean seeding in Illinois jumped to 93 percent complete as of Sunday, well above the 40 percent a year ago and the 67 percent average pace, according to the Illinois Agricultural Statistics Service.
Corn crop conditions were 11 percent excellent, 54 percent good, 31 percent fair, three percent poor and one percent very poor.

Wheat was 90 percent headed, the same as a year ago and below the 95 percent average heading pace. Seven percent of the crop was turning yellow, the same as a year ago but below the 20 percent average yellowing pace.
Wheat was nine percent excellent, 63 percent good, 21 percent fair and two percent poor.
Oats conditions were eight percent excellent, 69 percent good, 21 percent fair and two percent poor.
Pasture conditions were 10 percent excellent, 62 percent good, 24 percent fair, three percent poor and one percent very poor.
